unresolved: 14/10 mm OD/ID is a same-2-mm-wall layout reference; bending, torsion, buckling, landing loads and fatigue have not been sized.

1900 mm span preview: added mass and 14 mm spar loads require sizing; previous L/D and energy estimates do not validate the extended geometry.
frame_layout: Two vertical links at rear wing spar, joining upper and lower landing-gear legs and rear wing. All tilt together.
wing_rails_location: Closed wing tips at Y +/-775 mm, one straight tube each

battery_pod.shape: Smooth asymmetric oval with elliptical YZ sections and local hardware openings

wing_design_candidate.qualification: Geometry parameters only. Historical 1700 mm forces and performance are not a 1900 mm result.

compact_prop_screening.scope: Moving mesh vertices, face centres and edge midpoints versus conservative battery box, fixed support boxes / 18 mm-radius housing envelope and ideal prop disks. Intended tube/bearing/shaft-fit contacts excluded. Sampled, not continuous proof or full pairwise audit; mesh error, flex and fits unbounded.

symmetric_trimmed_gear_screening.scope: New gear only; full prior airframe checks retained. Sampled geometry, not continuous collision proof; flex, tolerances and mesh errors unresolved.

outer_tip_spar_screening.scope: Moving mesh vertices, face centres and edge midpoints versus conservative battery box, fixed support boxes / 18 mm-radius housing envelope and ideal prop disks. Intended tube/bearing/shaft-fit contacts excluded. Sampled, not continuous proof or full pairwise audit; mesh error, flex and fits unbounded.

vertical_gear_link_screening.scope: Moving mesh vertices, face centres and edge midpoints versus conservative battery box, fixed support boxes / 18 mm-radius housing envelope and ideal prop disks. Intended tube/bearing/shaft-fit contacts excluded. Sampled, not continuous proof or full pairwise audit; mesh error, flex and fits unbounded.

current_changed_part_clearance_checks.scope: Changed mesh vertices, face centers and edge midpoints. Conservative uncut pod bounding box; four ideal propeller cylinders. Wing/motor relative clearance invariant under their shared rigid transform. Intended socket/tube contacts excluded from pairwise testing.
current_changed_part_clearance_checks.uncertainty: Sampled checks, not continuous or exact minimum distances; no flex/tolerance/strength or aerodynamic validation. Coordinate-data and curved-tip discretization errors are not globally bounded.

wingtip_revision.root_thickness: Matched upper/lower half spacing; earlier factor-of-two error corrected
wingtip_revision.qualification: Geometric refinement: sealed tube-cover connection, less projection, smooth root and crown. CFD candidate; no comparative aerodynamic optimum established.

piped_joint_preview.socket_grip_extension: Additional 2 nominal spar diameters at each available gripping end. Pass-through sleeves extend on both ends; tube-end sockets extend inward only.
extension_limits: Inboard center-axle collars stop before the fixed bearings; extension is outboard only.
Wingtip sleeves extend toward the existing spar. Gear spar end trims are explicitly recorded.
Gear tips terminate 5 mm inside their bends; skid sleeves retain 50 mm grip.
Bearing seats and hollow connector spines are not spar-gripping sockets and retain their dimensions.
piped_joint_preview.gear_elbows: Four round 19.2 mm diameter elbows without raised straight end nubs. Actual skid tips cut 16 mm per end; rear-link tips cut 5 mm per end. Tips stop 5 mm inside bend crossings.
piped_joint_preview.qualification: Mesh preview only. Socket bores use 0.2 mm diameter allowance. Retention, bearing fits, loaded strength and continuous collision clearance are not certified. No manufacturing exports or new CFD.

fit_and_motion_audit.scope: Joint/tube overlap uses booleans on cleaned copies of actual preview meshes; 0.02 cubic mm reporting threshold. Motion checks sample vertices, face centers and edge midpoints against conservative pod and fixed-support bounds, plus ideal prop disks of 16 mm thickness. Intended tube bore and bearing contacts excluded from motion checks. Not continuous collision proof, physical fit or strength certification.

current_joint_screening.scope: Joint/tube overlap uses booleans on cleaned copies of actual preview meshes; 0.02 cubic mm reporting threshold. Motion checks sample vertices, face centers and edge midpoints against conservative pod and fixed-support bounds, plus ideal prop disks of 16 mm thickness. Intended tube bore and bearing contacts excluded from motion checks. Not continuous collision proof, physical fit or strength certification.

fairing_revision.qualification: Mesh preview: vertices and face-centre motion samples, not continuous collision proof. Tip surface normal offsets sampled at vertices; no certified wall thickness, fit, loaded flex or new CFD. Previous L/D is not a result for this new fairing geometry.

continuous_tip_revision.profile: Original S1223 normalized ordinates retained by uniform XZ section scaling; quintic spanwise blend, zero first and second derivative at both ends.
continuous_tip_revision.tip: Historical shared-height and 60-degree-cant loft, with continuous tube allowance. No local shoulder solids, Boolean planform trims or planar corner caps.
continuous_tip_revision.qualification: Mesh preview. Socket cover tested at vertices with 0.75 mm normal offsets. No certified fit or wall thickness; no new CFD.

historical_loft.method: Root contour to common ceiling, cubic smooth blend plus quadratic cant rise.

inner_tip_trim_revision.qualification: Mesh preview. Subtraction only; outboard surface vertex distances checked to 0.005 mm tolerance. Cutter tested against socket and tube vertices plus 0.75 mm normal offsets, not certified skin thickness, fit or loaded-flex clearance.

integrated_wing_tip_revision.qualification: Single connected watertight mesh preview; local bounded surface smoothing. Mesh approximation and socket cover samples checked, not manufacturing fit, loaded strength or CFD validation.

smooth_corner_loft_revision.method: Additive 45 mm circular inner-opening fillets with continuous height-field extension; Boolean union with the previous material.
smooth_corner_loft_revision.qualification: Watertight mesh preview from smooth fields with sampled hardware clearance. Corner fairing profiles changed; original L/D does not apply. Not exact CAD, certified manufacturing fit or structural qualification.

span1900_revision.washout: Existing profile stations are smoothly reparameterized along Y; root and tip angles retained.
span1900_revision.mesh_note: Existing mesh topology retained. C2 span mapping can lengthen some triangles; this is a preview, not a remeshed manufacturing artifact.
span1900_revision.qualification: Geometry-only mesh preview. Existing clearances retained; changed geometry is separated from the old rotor region across linked tilt. Previous sampled socket/fairing fit remains sampled evidence. Added structural weight, 14 mm spar strength, deformation, complete pitch trim and new drag are not validated.

full_oval_pod_revision.cross_section: True ellipse; Z follows a smooth asymmetric oval. Broad Y shoulders enclose the unchanged rectangular battery.
full_oval_pod_revision.qualification: Outer-fairing reference mesh with local bearing/support/axle clearances. Landing gear is already outside its width throughout linked tilt. Vertex/face-centre sweep at 0.5 degrees plus targeted mesh intersections is not an exact continuous clearance proof. Prop gap is only 3 mm geometrically, without flex allowance. Wall thickness, internal mounts, manufacture and new aerodynamic performance remain unverified.

internal_center_lock_revision.qualification: Sampled mesh layout. Cam contact, material/load sizing, servo and springs, plate reinforcement/fasteners and full 35 mm shaft/bearing/root conversion remain preliminary. Pod is an outer fairing reference, not a wall-thickness design.
ui_checks: One servo releases catch then withdraws pin
Returned to locked 0 with cutaway egg visible

simple_internal_slider_lock_revision.retention: Powered servo holding; optional axial ring magnet assist. No independent catch or spring return.
simple_internal_slider_lock_revision.qualification: Sampled mesh preview. Servo torque, magnetic retention, loss-of-power behavior and structural capacity not qualified. Full 35 mm tube/bearing/socket conversion remains deferred.
